description: Return the slowest components in a loaded Next.js render profile, ranked by total actual render time.

limit.description: How many components to return. Defaults to 10.

minSelfDuration.description: Minimum total self duration in ms to include — the same metric the default "total" sort ranks by, excluding time spent in children. Filters sub-millisecond noise. Defaults to 0.

sortBy.description: Sort metric: "total" = total render time (default), "average" = average per render, "max" = peak single render time.

name: get_slow_components
title: Get Slow Components
